bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10. MEDIA SPIN must be forgiven for his defeat at very short odds when there were excuses at Warren. He can atone when he returns to his home base this afternoon. BLOOMIN' HELL became most unsuited in transit at Forbes when her unplaced effort was better than it appears on paper within this distance range. WHISPERING LEGEND first trialed back in June of last year. She also trialed twice last month and she's more than ready to make her race-day debut today, at her home base. FORWARDING has finished unplaced on heavy tracks at both starts since a stable change. He will clearly have scope to improve when he presents today for the third time since a stable change and after a freshen-up with numerous gear changes made!

raceTips.comment: Media Spin still has a lot to learn but has ability and was strong to/through the line last time despite being beaten at a very short quote. No improvement is required to win this and the extra ground looks ideal. Herr Fritz got a mile back on debut but will have derived benefit from the run. The rise in distance looks ideal. Bloomin' Hell sets up for a cushy run and is at peak fitness. Whispering Legend has shown enough at the trials to suggest ability.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11. FINANCE WORK begins his second campaign, after a stable change, at his new home base. He trialed nine days ago at Gilgandra with his trainer/jockey, Kody Nestor aboard and he's ready to fire here first up. TAMPA BAY was produced second up and after a five week break when he kept trying at Forbes. This much quicker back-up must today be regarded as a plus. SPECTACULAR STAR should not be harshly judged for an unplaced first up Coonabarabran effort when there were excuses! THE LAST ROMANOV endured too tough a run in transit when he was resuming at Gunnedah. He will have scope to improve today when he presents for the second time since a stable change. ORCHID BOY and EL TRAPO, (who is trained here at Dubbo), are debutants who have both trialed recently and they can play a part in this class at start number one.

raceTips.comment: Orchid Boy moved tidily to/through the line in a recent trial, notably with Matthew Cahill aboard who rides here. He is ideally drawn and strikes a winnable race on debut. Finance Work clearly has the best form lines for the races brigade and his trial was solid. Just needs some luck from a wide draw. Tampa Bay wasn't beaten far last time but has had plenty of chances. Poetic Way has been freshened and can improve in this weaker jurisdiction.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 13, 16. BONCAPO scored with authority at Warren last start with Jacob Stiff aboard. He has been kept fresh since and he should have more to offer this afternoon when he returns to his home base with Jacob retaining the ride. DIVINE CONCLUSION found the line strongly to score after a twenty-two day break at Forbes last start. Stepping up from 1400m after this quicker back-up opens the door to further progression. GRANDE DIABLO was partnered by Aaron Bullock for the first time when he looked the part at Gunnedah in a race that's produced strong form. He can cope with this switch back from 2150m when he presents after a freshen-up today. GREEN PINEAPPLE finished unplaced last start at Hawkesbury however, his effort was better than it appears on paper  and switching to the country circuit aids his cause today. MISS DEFY struck too many traffic problems in this class first up at Gunnedah. She can make a mockery of her unplaced effort when she now presents race-fitter.

raceTips.comment: Very open race. Keen to have something on Proclivity at the odds. Backing up quickly after a very good run last week when covering ground without cover. Had excuses two back as well. Grande Diablo relished rising to a staying trip last time out and will have fans on that effort. Not worried about the drop back in trip. Boncapo covered ground throughout last time but still won impressively. Divine Conclusion is another last start winner and has a claimer aboard to remain weighted the same.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 7, 8, 10, 13, 16. PANTA RHEI handed in a solid front-running first up Warren effort and he's more suitably placed in this class today. TORENNDOSETTA has won two races here recently within this distance range and notching a hat-trick is now well within her reach. IMASTATEMENT presents first up today at her home base. Her first up Wellington effort last preparation was more than solid in a race that produced three subsequent start winners. BILLABONG ROSE is resuming. She hasn't been given a lead-up trial but unless market moves after she parades suggest otherwise, in her case there's no concern. She has won first up without a lead-up trial before! STEET PARADE finished unplaced in stronger class last start at Forbes when his effort was better than it appears at face value.

raceTips.comment: Imastatement tends to race well fresh and sets up as the map horse of the race. Good record over this trip and with Izzy Neale aboard. Torendosetta is going for a hat-trick at track/trip and again gets weight relief with a 4kg claimer engaged to ride. Panta Rhei is a very consistent mare who will strip much fitter from a solid first up run. Senior rider on and has upside, the back end of this trip is of some query though. Leuca was a strong winner two back (albeit in a modest maiden) but had excuses last time out. Can run much better than pricing suggests.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 10. WAVE BREAKER has been given a freshen-up since her unplaced Tamworth effort was better than it appears at face value in stronger class. One of her best efforts to date was achieved after an almost identical break. FETES DES MERES resumes from a long spell at her home base after trialing late last month at Warren with Jacob Stiff aboard. She shouldn't be underestimated. CASTLEBAR ROAD led throughout at Gilgandra nine days ago and he can maintain his form today without causing a surprise. CROOK was produced within this distance range last start at Canterbury when she was anything but disgraced. She's clearly better suited here, at home base this afternoon!

raceTips.comment: Fetes Des Meres appeals at the price on the back of a forward trial effort leading in. Some of her prior form lines jump off the page relative to this and she won her only other start here. Not Written Off is hard-fit and in form so no knock whatsoever. Cresta Run was about half a length off her two runs back, albeit with every chance, but has to be in the mix. As does Crook who continues to race consistently.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 10. PROPER TWELVE did all but lead throughout after a fifty-eight day break last start at Forbes. He can only present race-fitter when he presents within the same distance range at his home base today.  DE JOKER kept trying in defeat after he became unsuited in transit at home (Bathurst) last start. Stepping up from 1300m aids his cause today. SELLICKS BEACH was attempting to take the step out of maiden grade when he struck traffic problems at Bathurst at only start number two and when he was tackling a significant distance rise. He's better placed now. JENNI LA ROCK has been produced twice since a stable change. She made improvement at Muswellbrook last start and she can further improve with that effort now behind her.

raceTips.comment: Sunday ran on strongly into the minor money last time out and on that effort appeals at the odds. Concede she can mix form, but she has a good affiliation with Pracey-Holmes and a race like this is within reach. Proper Twelve was only narrowly beaten last time out and maps for an easy on speed run. Subject to early market support, he will take running down. De Joker has raced on well since a dominant maiden win three starts back. Sellicks Beach strips fitter third up and has a lot of upside being so lightly raced.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 8, 10, 15, 16. SHAMEDY presents third up. His effort within this distance range was honest at Grafton when he was produced fresh last start and this race will be within his reach when he presents fresh again today. HIBIKI HARMONY finished unplaced when her first up Muswellbrook effort was better than it appears at face value. Gear changes have now been made and the claim for Nick Palmer aids her cause second up. PRINCE OF SORTS endured a tough run in transit before he refused to shirk his task in defeat last start at home (Wyong). He was a winner at his only previous Dubbo appearance. NOMORENIGTHSHIFT was resuming when he caused his own problems with a poor getaway at Muswellbrook. He will have scope to improve here second up when he tackles a distance rise this afternoon.

raceTips.comment: Navy Steel covered ground throughout when resuming so I'm inclined to be forgiving. Fitter/further suits, and the addition of a tongue tie is an important gear change to note. Prince Of Sorts is ready to peak third up and has a good record over this distance range. Shamedy was a solid winner two back before running on soundly last time out. Best efforts are right up to this. Hibiki Harmony next.
